Title: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
FullTitle: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
SortTitle: Scary Stories to Tell in the Dark
Plot: Mill Valley, Pennsylvania, Halloween night, 1968. After playing a joke on a school bully, Stella and her friends decide to sneak into a supposedly haunted house that once belonged to the powerful Bellows family, unleashing dark forces that they will be unable to control.
